run_generate_podcast: run generate_podcast from a script JSON file to produce an MP3 podcast output
run_tts_node: run tts_node to convert a Script object into parallel audio chunks via Volcengine TTS
create_text_to_speech: create text_to_speech call to convert a single text string into MP3 audio bytes
run_mix_audio: run mix_audio to combine a list of audio byte chunks into a single MP3 output
create_generate_markdown: create generate_markdown from a Script object to produce a formatted markdown transcript
